desc: Build the trie and record each word’s node path.
Compute per-depth counts of trie nodes with frequency at least `k`.
Implement a max-depth structure supporting temporary decrement/increment of per-depth valid-node counts.
Process every removal by invalidating only path nodes with frequency exactly `k`, querying the maximum valid depth, and rolling back.
Return zero for all indices when `n - 1 < k`; correctly handle duplicates and `k = 1`.
